dbang thamatshacad shā khyin 7 / 'jing rgyal dbang bsod namaṭa rgya mtsho/0rgyarje gzims khang gong gi phul skran bsod nams a shes dbang po/4)stong 'khor sprul pa'i sku/ stong 'khor zla brgyal mtshan gyi sprul skya stong 'khor yo na tan rgya mtsho yin/ rab byung dgu ba'i me yul lor 'khrudzas / dpung lo so gcig pa me phag ror gshegs/ 4)bstan 'dzin blo bzar rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub chen po sde pa skyed shod pa bstan 'dzin blo bzang rgyamatsho ste rab byung bcu ba'ichu dru la (spyi lo1593)lor 'khrungs/ dgung 6)ra drug steng dbus nas mamador byon/di'i phyi lo rab byung bcu ba'i sa lug (spyilo1619) lor gya khyung — dgon par phebs/ der bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad/ 4spros bral zab mo/ mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa'i thab mo stong ba nyid/ zhu〉da tshig 'da' dka' rdorje'i tha tshig ces ji ltar bcas pa las mi 'da' bar g.yar dam gnyan por khas blangs pa'i tha tshig 6yibaskyed rdzogs bsgoms pa/ bla med rgyud kyi bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis bsgomspa/ 6)dam nyams/ dpar dam gnyan por khas blangs pa'i dam tshig nyams pa po/811
rgyal ba rmyo bzang rgya cha/ tsho/kun gzigs lnga ba chen po blo bzang rgya mtsho ni/ yar lung 'phyengs rgyas yul du za hor gyi rigs pas yab mi dbang bdud 'dul rab brtan khu ra / yum yar 'brog khri dpa na gyi sras ni shu / dka' lha mdzes sanyi(ge kyi pas su rab byung bcu ba'i me sbrul (spyilo1617) lor sku 'khrungs/dgung lo drug pa chu byi (spyi lo1622) lor 'bras spu ngas su gdan drangs /paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan la gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan blo bzang rgya mtshor casol/ gling smad pa dkon mchog chos 'phel bsten nas bsdus tshad napo/ bzur pod chen rnams tshegs med du mkhyen/ paṇa chen rin po che 9/sa dbang lung man ngag mang du gsan/ smon 'gro pa ྅ ta tshe dbang do grupa pa ba sras las snyan ngag dang / sgra/ sdeb spyo ra sogs mthar phyin pa ra sbyangs/ sgra yi ri mo yongs rdzogs rgyugs 'dzod pa'i kun bshad kyi mtshan la 'jam dbyangs dka' ba'i bshes gnyan zhes btags/ sdu ma po don grub dbang rgyal dang zur chen chos dbyings rang grol las skar nag dbyangs 'char rtsis sogs gsan te bcu phrag rig pa'i ma hā pa3 ta chen por gyur/ 〉dgung lo nyar gnyis pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa stag (spyi lo1 638) lor paṇa chen rin po cher bla chen gyi sdom rgyun las bsnyen par rdzong/sa/ mtshan ngag gi dbang phyug ces gusar du bsnan/812
dgung lo nyer drug pa chu rta (spyi lo1642)lor gu shrī bston 'dzin chos / rgyal sgyur/ bod khri skor bcu gsum mchod gzhis su phul nas dga' ldan pho brang gi srogi dbang gzhi tshugs/ dmar po ri la pho brang chen po po ta la bzhengs/ dgung lo so drug pa chu 'brug (spyi la1652)lor 'jam dbyangs rnyo /nga ma shun ṭi rgyal po'i bka' bzhin pe cin du phebs/ gong mas 4nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng gi rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag ngo thams cad mkhyen pa badz+ra rta ra tā la'i bla ma zhes pa'i go ming dang 'ja' sa gser tham gnang / gser tham gyi ngos su5nub phyosas kyi phu tsho byung zhi ba sangs rgyas rgya chen kyon la saras rgyas bstan pa'i rna nga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang tā la 'i bla ma'i tham ga zhes 3 hor bod gsu ma gyi yi ge shan sbyar du bgad yod/ chu sprul lor rgya nag nas bod du phebs/ gong dkar bshad sgrub gling btab/92 re dbari ri nga56 che rtsu/ blo bzang chos rgyan dang / khri chen da7da mchos/ chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byoracad grub/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba/ dbu mdzad bsod nams mchog grub/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa/ sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas grub mang po bsten nas gsar rnying gi tsha sa tshul rgya mtsho lta bu bzhes par mdzad/ dbus gtsang khams sogs kyi yu la du chos sde gsar bzhengs bgrang gis mi lang rab byung bsnyen rdzorgarnga 'bogs pa'i dge slong ni sa chen po'i rdul lta bur snang /gsung rtsom rang nyid kyi rnam thar dang / bla ma'i rnam thar/ snyan ngag gi 813
'akrolaya/ rgyal rabs deb ther/ mtshan nyis miyig cha/ lam rim so sa phye mja 4da chesasum cu bzhugs pa dang / rdo rje zer ba sogasangasab /rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang 4 da 'chad spel ga nang ba sogs chu 'o gaṅgā'i shar phyogs kyi bla chen dang smra chen phal mo che zhal slob tu ma rgyur pa med pa lta ris rasnas4/ gsar phyogs la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dab/ rnying lugs la bya nga ba bzas stobs kyi lugs kho na thugs rtsis su mdzad/ 'khor lo gsu ma gyi phyag rjes/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mdzad pa dab rnam thar bsalagyis mi khyab/ dgung lo re drug pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi (spyi lo1682) lor sku gshegs/rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bstod pa ta m+bu ra' rgyud mangs/na mo ā spyo maklu shri ye/ mkha' khyab ①don dam chos sku yilha yi lam/ /bcu drug bde chen mtshanabazar dbang po'i gzhu/ /gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba'i sgyu dra'i gar/ /ston mdzad 'jam mgon zur phud lnga bar ②'dud/ /chu skyes 'dab brgya rgod pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /rab gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas steng / /gur kum rdul mang brtsegs pa'i nyun po ke/ /nyi ma byi ge'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /bcu drug lang tsho darangaba'i 'jo sger can/ /rgyal sras gzhon nur ston 'di ringaji po nas/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi yab ces rgan po'i mtshan/ /'chang ba'i gtam 'de thol gyis sgrib 814
pa bzhin/ /mtshams sprin mongs kyi ri thubamarag ltamadangs dbyibartega zugs sku'i bkod pa jibye ba'i tshogs/ /mtha' mid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma bskams bar/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i don du bstan las ci/ /mig gi bdud rtsir spyod pa'i mdzes sduka sku/ /phun tshogs mtshan dpe'irigasho bkra ba gang / /mthong thorme dran dnga'ag bas rnal 〈li bca/ /'di ko skal bzang gdul bya'i bsod nams denyid/ /de don rtogs pa'i blo gros ches phra rnams/ /sna tshogs rin chen phreng ba'i do shal dang / /palca li kha'i da ra 3 sham thabs la/ /bsngags brjod dar dir sgrog pro ngalariba'i gnas/ /srid zhi'i rgyad pa mig sman ltar gnag pa/ /mthar byed nā da'i sgra dbyangs rta ljang can/ /rgol ngan smra pa'i ku mud zum pa dang / /dpyod ldan blo gros pad dkar 'dzum gyis bsu/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i glu/ /skal bzang rna bar 'jebs pa tshangs pa'i gsung / (ches cheralongs pa'i 'gro la zasaca'i sgra/ /mi bzad bdud sde'i snying la tsher ma banan/ /chu klung gcig la snag khyag bdud rtsi sogs/ /sna tsho 4/sa du mar snang zhing don phyed pa/ /kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i chosalakun don dam dgyings/ /ma rnyed dbu ma'i lam bzang ston pa bzhin/ /skad cig tsam la rgya chen shes bya'i mtha'/ /'jal nus zab yangs thugs kyi rgya mtsho cher/ /grangs med chos kyi ri bong 1dzin pa'i gzugs / /mi 'char lkog tu gyuraride da ga re/ /phul byung bugs pa'i laṅka'i bdag po'i phu〉gzugs/ /blo ldan snying gi rin chen jig ngos la/ /shar tshe lnga rig ha nu ma3yigang / /dga' ba'i zlos gar sgyur la ci yang brel/ /chos brgyad 'bod sgrogs ②'phrul gyis nyer 815
pa ras pa'o/ /dartsa ga la pa tsha sa r+nghi 4ri/ tā 'dir byas nas/ /'anyar snang tradze+e /sa snyeg la mngon pyod kyis/ /mi pha na byang banyidu/ nyu ka par nyi gzer ga ldan/ /gtan gyi skyabs0su gsol na smos ci 'tshal/ /cung zad dran pas phan bde'i legs tshogs rnamari sga/ /stsol mdza da 'dod pa 'i re sko nga dbang gi rgyal/ /sngon med yid bzhim/ nar bu gzhan na su/ /'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /pha mje' kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram pa la/ /'jal byed 'dzad pa med pa'i zhags pa yi rnga / /sri da dang zhi ba'i dngos kun gcib tu bcings/ /phra zhib rnam par dpyod pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan/ /dkyus ring zur gyis 'phangs pa'i nyag phran gyis / /mtha' med khengs ldan shes bya lus phra ma/ /kun yid dga' ba'i 'dzu 8 dang bca sa te bsu/ /brtse chen dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal yangs nas / /lhag bsam chu 'dzin gsar ba'i lang long can/ /rlabs chen spyod pa⑨mtshag gi char rgyun gyis/ /phan dang bde ba'i myu gu g.yur du za/ /dbang phyug mig las sbar ba'i me dpung gis(tshe/ /nyag phran bdag po bcom pa nges par rdzun/ /bden na khyod kyi nus mthu'i thog mda' yis/ /nag/ po'i phyog/sa rnams cig car bcom min nam/ /khyod dang ma la yar skyes ljon pa gnyis/ mi shes tsha gdung 'dzoms la mtshungs na yang / /mgon khyod nyes pa'i skyon bral ngag gi lha/ /sdon shing de gdug pa'i sbrul gyis 'khril/ /e ma ngo mtshar mkha' la nyi zla zung / /chos bzang lha yi mdun sar③mig stong can/ /grangs med rkang 'thung khrod na yongs 'du'i ljon/ /rgyal sras 'phab/sa rtsags dbus na 'jam dbyangs khyod/ /mchog dman kun la nya da nga ring med 816
bar/ /gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'bod pa'i don/ /rgyun grub re ba gi'u cari lkong byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu klu dbang gtsug na mdzes/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ral gri yis/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i dra ba bcad pa dang / /lhan cig 'khor ba sdug bsngal kun gyi rgya/ /dral te 'gro rnams bde ba chen por 'khrid/ /gang gi gsang gsum0byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skye dgu'i yid kyi yol gor 'khyil ba na/ /shes ldan dad pa'i bstod bsngags zil mngar chu/ /mgon khyod thugs kyi pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur 'bab/ /mtha' bral rlabs chen mdzad pa mchog gi nor/ /phyur bur spungs pa gcig tu shong ba'i snod/ /sprul la 'jig rten mes po ngal gyur na/ /srid gsum 'di yang da dung chung ngur khums/ /chos phung rgya mtshor shar ba'i pusti ma0//phrag gong ut+pal 'dab steng mngon chags pa/ /blta phyir lhun pos nyi zla'i sgron me zung / /bteg nas ngal med lta bar chas pa bzhin/ /thabs shes zung 'jug ①rgyud las drangs pa'i mdas/ /gti phug snying ga phug pa'i khrag gi rgyun/ /'gro la rjes chags dmar ba'i 'od gzi la/ /thun mtshams mdangs su byed pos btegs sam snyam/ /rgod ma kha la 'gran bzod zhabs sen gyis/ /'jam mnyen chu skyes 'dab ma sreg go zhes/ /ri bong 'dzin de tsha ba'i gdung sel slad/ /mkha' las babs nas stan du 'ong ba bzhin/ /chos kun mkhyen yang slob pa 'phags pa'i tshul/ /drang po'i sku yang 'phyog po'i 'akying bag can/ /zhi zhing dul yang bdud sde'i tshogs la khro/ /kun nga brtse yang skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /mdzon khyod thugs rje'i zegs ma ma 'dris pa'i/ /lus can rnams la 'jug sa rdzun gtam ste/ /817
tsan+d+ra rga mi ⑨mkhas pa'i mthar son yang / /da dung skye dgu phal cher rnam par rmongs/ /'gro kun 'dzum gyis bsu ba'i zhal khyim la/ /gur kum gsar ba'i mdangs la dmar 'od can/ /'char ba'i ro la 'tshol ba'i spyan gyi dkyus/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las rnam par brgal/ /yid 'ong gdub si la 'khrol ba'isnyan po'i sgra/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsir byed pa'i 'od dkar can/ /yid bzhin 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /rtsed 'dzor rol ba'i 'dab chags ngang ba su/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i phung bo dang / /khyod nyi rnam par yangs pa'i blo gros gnyis/ /'jig rten mes pos srang la bteg pa na/ /klu dang yang ba'i go skabs med 'di mtshar/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang 'dren pa kun/ /kun dga'i legs bshad spel phyir rgyal ba'i sras/ /sras bcas rnams kyi gtsug na mtho ba'i lha/ /lha mchog 'jam da pal dbyangs zhes grags pa 'bar/ /ngag gidabang po dbang 4ga brgyad ldan ⑤pa/ /thams cad mkhyen de mkhyen brtsi nus pa'i dpyid/ /sgrib gnyis las bral las can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mchog gi dngos grub dngos su stsol la mkhas/ /mtshams 6na mdangs 'dzin 'dzin ma yongs kyi rgyan/ /rgyan phreng gis mdzes mdzes rnag ga zhon nu'i gzugs/ /gzugs sku ngo mtshar mtshar sdug 'dzin ba'i mgon/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs dbyangs bdun legs bshad 'khrol/ /dung cing jiyid kyis rtag tu lhar bsten na/ /brtan brtan ting gi pad mtshor m+wagagacazhugs nas/ /'grig 'grig gsung gi snang ma legs stsol zhing / /yang yang thugs rje'i phyag gis dbudas dbyung 818
mdzad/ /ldem ldem nga/d+ma'i 'dab na rgyas pa'i dbus / /dkar dkar chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor steng / /mdzes/ mdzes gcig tu bsdus pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku/ /gsal gas 9ri kun rtog pir kyis ci yang 'bri/ /pha mtha' mi rna ngon tshang tshir rnam par 'khrigs/ /kha dog rab dkar kha ba'i reg byas gdungs / /tsha grang mi snyoms tha ga pa yi yul/ /ṭha ka ra la 'thob byar 'dzin pa dmas / /mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pas nyer bsgribs pas/ /mu med sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i rgyu sgrub par/ /me tog bcud la bung ba ltar 'khor ba'i/ /ma lus 'gro ba drongs shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ka ma la ltar 'jam mnyen gzugs kyi sku 'i/ /kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i bkod pa dang / /ga bur ngad ltar gdung sel thugs rje'i phyag /nga rgyal can gyi 'gro ba'i gtsug na khyongs / /ca co legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs snyan po/ /cha shas res kyang yid dang rna ba la/ /ja dkar btung bas rig pa'i mdangs gsal ltar/ nya rgyas zla ltar blo gros 'phel bar mdzod/ /ta la'i glegs bam rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /tha na chung ngu'i dka' gnad tsam la yang / /da lta thogs med smra ba'i spobs pa mchog /nā gā rdzu na'i⑧rnam dpyod ltar mtshungs mdzod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar mkhas pa'i bya ba kun/ /pha rol rgol ba zil gyis gnon nus pa/ /ba gling dbus na khyu mchog ji ba'i/na du/ /ma lus shes ldan rnams kyi mgon du mdzod/ tsa na yin kyang dngos su zhal bstan nas/ /tsha zer spyan ngang pad+ma ji bzhin du/ /dza ya'i0gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig /wa ler gsal ba'i shes rab gsal bar mdzod/ /zha yig ltar 'khyil 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang / /za byed nyon mongs chu srin 819
gdug pas gtsis/ /'a 'ur mi bzad sdug ba595 ldan pa rnams/ /tsomtshan dag pa'i zhing du khyod kyis drongs/ /ra ba mes pa 'i phug pa'i blun sgom dang / /la lung 'khyam 4 'i rtog ge ②kha bshag ca/khatsha// /sha khrag sdug la ro7ri ba'i kla klo'i sde/ /sa yi rdul ltar khyab rnams/ rjes 4 zungs/ /ha cang dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug 'dir/ /a do zla/ bskye med rtogs pa nyin rkakar tsam/ /ha la'i dug 'dra'i gnas ngan le'o/ 1—gyi rgyu/ /a rnga/) 'bras ltar myong rnams rjes brtser mdzod/ /de ltar du sa sasum rgyal ba pu na gyi yab/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin ngag gi lha/ /dran pas 5ma 'dren rin chen gling mchog tu/ /'khrid pa'i 〉da dpon brtan pa'i 'a/lor lo dkongs/ mi 'phrog dad sbra 'i shing rtas rab drangs pa'i/ /shugs drag smom/ la ma dkyil 'khor rta ljang can/ /snyan 'gyur tshig gi mkha' la nyer 'phags na/ /thugs rje'i pad dkar 'dab 34 'dzum las 'u/ /bzlog sogs mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /nyon mongs dug gsum drag po'i nad kyis gtses/ /gnas ngan len pa'i rgyu yi khur chen blangs/ /blapa dang gyur byar lta ba'i blo mig ldongs/ /mngon mtho jes legs lam0las rgyab kyis phyogs/ /mi bzad ngan song g.yang sar gom pa 'phyan/ /dge ba'i las kyi 'khar ba'i rten dang bral/ /nyam thag snying rje'i gnas su gyur rnams la/ /mtshan po khyod kyis rjes su mi 'dzin na/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas dam pa su la re/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub semasaḥldan pa'i/ /snyan pa'i gtam yang ming gi lhag ṇ+ṭha/ra zad/ /ches cher snyi gas ma lnga0yis nyer sngags pas/ /ha cang gdul bar dka' zhes btang 820

6ba skyusamasabaskyed tshul 6ga tutasnyigs ma lnga/ tsha'i skyegs ma dang / nyon rmangs pa'i snyigasom/ sems can gyi snyigs ma/ dus kyi snyigs ma/ lta ba'i tigs ma ste lnga'o/ /② bag la nyal/mi mngon par gnas pa'am lkog tu gyur pa/ pho〉mi gnas myang 'das/〈〈mngon togs rgyan〉las/ shis pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes sna la mi gnas pas/ /zhes pa ltar shes rab zab pas srid pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa dang / thabs rgya che bas zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa 'dod pa'am sgrub pa'i theg pa chen po'o/ /ཿā dar+sha/ me long / 0rdo rje'irnal 'byor/ 'dir rig 'dzin gyisde snod la bshad pa ste/ 〈〈dpung bzang gis zhus pa〉〉las/ lha dang lha min mi la phan gdags phyir/ /gsang sngags rig sngags rnam pa sna tshogs dag /4 ba phrag gsum dang ni 'jum phrag ji / rig 'dzin sde snod bshad par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes dang /slo ba dpon ny+pha dhā ka ras/ de la gsang sngags kyi the pa'i sde snod ni theg pa gsum du ma gtogs spra ra 'dod de/ de ni rig 'dzin gyis snod ces grags par byang chub sems dpa'i lde stod gzhan yin rna zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa gsum dang rig 'dzin gyi re snod na bzhi yod par gsungs/826

kun+da'i tshogs kyi do bla min/ /spru ba'i bapa mdzod yi sgyud zang stong / /rnam par 'thul yang tshul 'ad brjod pa'i mtha'/ /sprul phyir rdzogs par gleng ba'i dka' thub dag /bsten na tshangs pa rgan po gnyid la yur/ /'on kyang rang blo'i a mra'i tshi gu yis/ /rtogs brjod zla ba'i ma ma'i cha shas las/ /ji tsam len par slobs nus de srid du/ /'jug pa 'i tshul la rgol ba'i klan ka su/ /ye shes snang ba dudag pa'i zhing / /lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen gzhir/ /nor bu'i rdul brtses/sa ri bo'i tshogs/ /gnyis 'thung dal gyis rgyu ba bzhin/ /sna tshogs rin chen las bskrun pa'i/ /sngon med ljon pa'i dbang po can/ /nyon mongs gdung ba las skyob phyir/ /'dab ma'i tshogs kyis klubs sam snyam/ /dal 'bab chu klung sdig pa'i dri/ /'khrud pa'i cho ga bltar ba la/ /chu skyes tshogs rnams dga' ba'i 'ju ma /rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa 'dra/ /lha mi'i 'byor ba ji snyed pas/ /dpe zlar 'os min ngo mtshar gyi/ /bkod pa rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas ni/ /bde ba can ②zhes grags pa dkar/ /sa gzhi dang ri dang shing tham sa cad kyang rin po che las grub cing / mtsho rdzing 'bab chu me togbya skad snyan sgrog pa/ 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo sogs ngo mtshar dang ldan pa'i bde ba can gyi zhing de'i dbus su khang bzang dang byang chub shing gi ljon pa yod do/ /zhing de'i gabang phyug 'od dpag med①/ /'khor mun mig sman ltar gnag pa/ /mthar byed sku gsung thugs kyi gzi/ /gtan bde'i 828

mgon 'jam dpal snying po'i gdams pa'i bcud/ /dpal 'dus pa'i snyan rgyud zhal gdams dang / /sngags gsar rnying gi dkyil 'khor mtha' kras par/ /rgyud smin byed dbang gi cho ga nos/ /lung man ngag phyag bzhes ji snyed pa'i/ /gnad dka' ba'i phrang la zhun thar bcad/ /ye dge ba'i rig pa kun tu bzang / /ngo rjen sprod theg pa'i yang rtse bstan/ /kha phyir bltas sems kyi tha rgod dag /rgyun chad med nges 'byung gis brlan nas/ /chos snying nas bsgrub blo'i myu gu 'di/ /drin 'khor thabs med de'i thugs rjer nges/ /lo nyer gnyis dus su tshigs snga ma'i/ /mkhan slob dpon dge 'dun bcu tshogs dbus/ /gnas 'phrul snang shākya mu rna'i drung / /khrims tshangs spyod kyi gtso bo bsnyen par rdzogs/ /der mkhan chen 'gro ba'i bla ma'i0drung / /dpal rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yi/ /gsung dri med 'ga' sogs lung gi rigs/ /'gro gang che sna chogs kha yar thob//phyi tha snyad mkhyen pa'i slob dpon 'gar/ /rtsis dkar nag snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang / /ming mngon brjod ka tsan ⑨brda' sprod gzhung / /don phyogs tsam rig pa'i bslab sbyangs bgyis/ /zur rig 'dzin pad+ma rdo rje'i drung / /don yang zab thugs sgrub rnam gsum dang / /lha ma gshin gza' gdong dregs pa sogs/ /las rnam bzhi'i man ngag mtha' klas thob/ /blo mi bsrun bstan 'gro'i phan bde rnams/ thabs du mas 'joms pa'i dgra sde'i tshogs/ /don bde chen rang snang mi bskyod pa'i/ /zhing dag pa'i mgron du bos snyam bgyid/ /brda' 'dod rgyal tsam gyis btags min pa'i/ /don gnas lnga rig pa'i parnyi ta/ /bod gangs can yul gyi 845
dgi ba'i dbang / /skad rnam gnyas smra ba'i smon 'gro parayi/ /lha gzhon nu gdong drug bzhed srol gyi/ /gzhung dri ma med pa'i cha bas /sa mdo③/ /dpal btsun pa zla ba'i tsan+d+ra pa/ /gnad zhib mor ri mo gtan la phab/ /yul dbus 'gyur du zla bral sharnyi pa'i/ /skyon kun bral sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung / /ming zad pa med pa'i 'chi med mdzod/ tshul dgongs don ma lus lhug par bkrol/ /nyams 'gyur ba stong gi 'dzum zhal can/ /ngag smra ba'i 'byung gnas me long gi/ don snga na med pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /mi kho bo'i rna bar bdud rtsi byin/ /dpal dus 'khor dbyangs 'char jis kyi gzhung //thon sasto ṭa yi sum rtags sogs/ /bod cher rlom phal gyis shes min pa'i//yid kun dga' bskyed pa'i ltad mo mthong / /yul rgya bal bod 'dir bsod nams kyi/ /zhing dam par bskrun pa'i sku gzugs dang / /hor ñtsa dag gi rol cha gan gos sogs/ /yongs dngos po'i brtag thabs ji snyed rig /tshis/ dam dum bcad pa'i rtsom pa dang / /skad rdo chag bsgrigs kyi legs sbyar la/ /ngang mkhas par sgrub pa'i re ba dag /byed ma dgos mkhas dbang khyod kyi drin/ /rje bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel la/ /dpal byang chub lam rim 'dus pa yi/ /gnad 'khrul med rgyal dbang tsong kha pa'i/ /lugs ji bzhin zhib mor nyan pa'i tshe/ /chos mtha' dag mngon sum lag mthil nang / /da ston par 'dug snyam byed nus pa'i/ /'chad mkhas la zla bral rnam dpyod mchog /de bsams kyin mkhas pa'i yang rtser 'khums/ /rigs kun khyab pad+ma badz+ra las/ dpal the / pa'i yang rtse bzang thal sogs/ /dbang rig gtad nyams 'khrid rgyab brten 846
lung / /zab rgya che'i bdud rtse rmad du byung / /mgon rdo hra 'chang dbang bsod nams drung / /chos yang zab gsung ngag slob bshad ma chog /dbang rdo rje phreng sogs spyi bka' dang / /gzhan zur bka' mang po'i smin grol mdzad/ /lar gsang chen gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /pha rdo rje 'chang dbang rnam pa gnyis/ yongs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar gyis/ /bod gangs can 'di 'og min zhing du byas/ /khas nyer blangs bslab la nan tan dang / /yid lhag bsam gyis rab drangs bshad sgrub sogs/gang ci nus su byed par rlom 'di yang / /rten dal 'byor don ldan du byas sam snyam/ /blo nang du bkug nas nyer bsams na/ /don go yu la du lus pa'i kha bshad kyis/ /gzhan 'gro phan du rlom pa'i rnam/ g.yeng 'di//kun thabs mkhas kyis phongs pa'i bslu brid mkhan/ /gnas ngan song gi sdug bsngal me 'obs dong / /srid 'khor ba'i btson dong mtha' med nags/ /srog mi rtag glog gi rol sar ma/ban/ /'di mthong bzhin sgrub las g.yel bas nongs/ /sngon chos brgyad gdon gyi dbang song ba'i/ /tshe don med du 'das pa'i ma lhag la/ /lha dkar mchog gsum gyi thugs rje yis/ /dus sa/tan 'dun 'grub pa'i bam/'a drin zhu/ /gong gi zhing bkod rnams kyi 'phros las/ cha/grin bzang gzig pags rgyan pa'i ngang tshul ltar/ bdag gi spyod tshul cung zad bri bar 'dod na/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshigs bcad rnams ha cang mangs par 'gyur bas/ po ta la'i sa 'dul la yongs skabs/ 'phags pa lo gi shwa ra phebs pa'i 'phags pa'i byin rlabaca/ kyi4ri ngo mtshar ba byung tshul dang / lha 847

pod mkhas pas pham dgi legs rnam rgyal/bod kyi snyan ngag pa chen po bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal ni/ rab byung bcu ba'i sa rta(spyi lo1618)lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo re gcig pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta(spyi lo1678)lor snyan 'grel daṭi'i dgongs rgyan brtsams zhes bstan jis kun btus las gsungs/dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho yid 6kyi ngang mo rnam rtsen tshangs pa'i mgrin rgyan rab dga'i rgyud mangs/rig 'dzin lha yi skyed tshal du/ /'jug pa'i 'phrin yig thabs shes kyi/ /'dab gshog g.yo ba'i blos gar mkhan/ /yid kyi ngang au rnam rtsen bzhugs/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sprin/ /rab zhi chos kyi dbyangasabadun rdzogs pa'i glus/ /bde ba chen po'i dpyid 'jo bcom ldan ma/ /ngag dbang lha yi bu mor btud nas de'i/ /thugs rje'i 'dab yangs stong du 'dzum pa'i rlabs/ /'gog med chos don zab cho/'i bdud rtsi'i ro/ /bcud len snying por sems pa'i rkang drug pa/ /ma brtags 863
nyams dga'i snyan tshig mgrin pa 'degs/ /legs byas dpal gyi dum bu'i nags kyi ljongs/ /lang tshor smin pa dal 'byor bzang po'i rten①//'thob par dka' yang lan cig brgya lam na/ /rnyed 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi 'bras ldan pas/ /dga' dang mos pa'i tshig sbyor gaṅgā'i rgyun②//kun mkhyen ral ba'i nags su 'khor 'dod kyang / /dus gzhan skal ldan shing rtas nyar drangs tshe/ /'dir snang khyab 'jug zhabs kyang bsil bar byed/ /yul gyi mngon 'dod gsar ba'i rtse dga' mar/ /srid pas bdungs pa'i nyam thag 'khor ba pa/ /sna tshogs myong ba'i khur gyis —yongs dub rnam sa/ /rang sems ngal 'tsho'i stegs bu 'di long zhig /skye bar 'dris pa'i bag chags bzang po yis/ /r+ya dun nas bsus pa dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i krogs/ /skal bzang dgi legs rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ /rang nyid nyer zhi'i dpal la yi da chags shing / /gnyis med gsung rgyun nga na lag brgyad ldan chab/ /lhag pa'i snying stobs 'dzin ma'i sno da yangs por/ /dogs pa med pa ra 'thung pa'i ma dros mtshozlo/ /rnam 'dren klu yi dbang po'i thug45 rje'i bya thu/ /rnam dpyod mchu sgros byi ru'i tshal nang skyes/ /legs nga shad ri brgya 'dzin pa'i pad+ma 'di/ /rnam par grol ba'i nyi zer 'thung 'dod pas/ /dad dang brtson pa'i 'khri shing kun nas g.yo/ /gang tshe legs ldan 'drags byed dga' ma'i mgrin/ /sngon goms/ rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i chu ris can/ /kun gsal nam mkha'i phang bar gnas bcas te/ /gnas 〉 bas bde bar rlom pa'i dus shig na/ /rig 'dzin lha yi skyed mos chal 'gram nas/ /dri za'i na chu nga grub 864
pa'i pho nya mos/ /bskul ba'i snyan tshig rgyud mangs las thon pa'i/ /'phrin yig kun dga' rgyas pa'i dbyangs ldan des/ /snying la bde ba'i dbugs 'byin lha brgya yi/ /gtam snyan rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ /snyan dang 'gyur bag stong gi bser bu'i rgyun/ /yid kyi shes pa bsil ba'i brten du 'bab/ /rang sems dri bral dar dkar chun po la/ /brtse ser/sa mi phyed phyag rgya'i mdud ldan pa/ /gzhan rkyen sor rtses 'byed pa'i go skabs kyang / /nam mkha'i tshal gyi pad dkar①dogs pa bzhin/ /nyi zer khu bas yongs smin ut+pala'i/ /'dab 'phreng rtse gar rgod pa'i khyim yangs por/ /bung ba'i na chung zang jig/ myos pa'i glu/ /sum rtsen tshal gyi gling bu'i sgra ltar snyan/ /'di na ngon pa'i glu las ri dwags bzhin/ /'khrul snang 'gog med myong ba'i mel tshe bas/ /sdug bsngal bde bar sems pas yid drangs te/ /lang tsho'i zer phreng nub rir 'chel la nye//yul gyi nags mthar rgyug pa yid shes kyi/ /bung ba las kyi bser bu'i gzhan dbang can/ /lha khyid dran pa'i sbrang rtsis yid bkug ste/ /gzhan du mi g.yo phyogs der khar ma khor /ring nas goms pa'i bag chags nags kyi gzhir/ /smon lam dri bzang mjag po 'thul ba'i grogs/ /kun las phul byung li shi'i gur khang na/ /rang snang bde ba'i bung ba kun dgar rgyu/ /mtha' med srid pa'i skyed tshal mngon yangs por las snang 'khrul rtog ha la'i me tog gi/ /ro bcud du kha rgyas pa'i kha zas 'di//rig sngags zab mos sman du byed nus sam/ /de skad glu yis gtams las rang gi sems/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa dkar phyogs zla ba'i cha/ /kun 65
phan ga pur chu rgyas spro rma khas des/ /legs pa'i la ma yangs gsal bzhin rab smras pa/ /mtshar sdus chu ris snying pos bkra ba'i 'dzum/ /snyan ༷/ paX /spya /sa ༵༵sa gzing ma paX'i kulhas da/ga'i spi/byi) spri ༵ sbyo/ /sna bde sngon 'dris mdza' ba ga bur dkar 'dzum gyi/ /reg pa phu tig 'khri shing tshal gyi gzhir/ /dbyangs can sor rtses blangs pa snyan tshig gi/ /ro bcud smin pa'i 'phrin yig me tog 'phen/ /gsu nga gi lhug phran las thon tshon brgya ba'i/ /'phrin yig ut+pal 4/sar ba'i chun po zhig /dā/dza' ba'i dri bsur mngar po 'bul bzhin du/ /rna ba'i dpyid du ring nas 'dodako pa snyam/ /nyams dang 'argyur bag stong gi ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /don bzang zil ba tshar du dngar ba'i bcud/ /bdag blo kedabyangs can grogs pos 'thungs pha'i mod/ /bde bas myos rta 'i pa /ra bcas glu yang len/ /sngon nas yongs 'dris bag chags yangs pa'i tshon/ /rang sems zla shel me long la 'dod pa/ /nam yang 'bral med snyan pa'i gtam gsar pas/ /mdza' ba dkar po'i bdud rtsis bran pa bzhin/ /g.yo med g.yung drung snying pos chad chags pa'i/ /btso sbyangs 4/ser ltar bzang ba'i sems yangkhams/ /mi 'gyur rdo ba'i ngos kyi re kha zhig /'di na bdag gi skal bar t+yā bar rgyu/ /〉gas ma rnam lnga'i①la nga mardzogs ldan pa 'i/ /dus ngan skye bo' spyod tshul snyon pa 'i gar/ /nges/ med g.yo ya nga yid brtan ma mchis pa/ /'di 'drar bdag sems 'dzag pa gang du bgyid/ /snyam sem/sa skyo shas lus kyi shugs ring gi/ /dbugs kyis mchu 'dab dasprul ni zil 66
mnan cing / /ut+pal rna rgyan rnyings pa 'gram pa'i gzhir/ /lhung ba'i ṭ+wāṃ (shāshā phyog( pya rin ༷gyi /spyan lta/ ba'i/ (dri spra miX shāl dbyi ((shārnyi /pa mthar 'phyan pha'i ri dwags mo/ /yid kyi shes pa skyo ba'i gar la 'jug /'ogasung zla ba3 sring mos0mchog sbyin pa'i/ /rig tshed snyan ngag dam pa'i bsil yab dkar/ /dal bu dal bur g.yob 'di sems nyid kyi/ /skyo dub sel ba'i rten du bzang zhing bsil/ /dus 'dir dag pa'i mkha' la rang snang gi/ /skye mched dran pas smin pa'i lang tsho mas/ /phan pa'i snying gtam gang sbyar lda rje'i gya②/ /rgyud mangs sgra las drangs te 'di skad zer/ /sna tshogs las kyi shing rtar zhon pa'i sems/ /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bur mi 'jigs na/ /lang tshos rdzogs pa'i mngon 'dod yon tan rna4 bas/ /mda' lnga'i cho gas rtsen la gyis mi 'jug /gzhon nu'i na tshod 2dzin pa'i mtshar sdug lus/ /gas dang 'chi ba'i gnod pas reg min na/ /mthing 'od ral pa'i zur phud na dzes chags pa/ /nyes med spru gris bsnyol ba()ji ltar rigs/ /rin chen rna rgyan 'khrol ba'i 'od ris kyis/ /mun pa'i phyogs la sa rgyal byed nor bu'i phreng / /lus sems mdzes pa rtag par gtong min na/ /rgyan med sna zhalas 'phyang ba ṇā ༵ ༵༵ ma/ ngon/ paX shā dī /min zu spri'i lus phra mi(ga ya /sdu /spyal/ ba'i/ pa/ /dri 'bras ldam/ na /dor nas kyung bzed dga' ba ji ltar skye/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i sa zas mngar po yis/ /lus kyi pad+ma dar ba'i skal bzang 867
cha/ /dus bzhi 'jig pa'i tshom pos mi 'phrog na/ /bsod snyom/sa tsam gyi 'tsho bar su zhig brten/ /sum rtsen ljon pa las babs bde chen gyi/ /reg bya ster ba kun rtsa lin+da'i gosang/ /'bral med lus kyi nyer 'tshor rtag 'grogs na/ /sha na'i gosan+t+rakyi gdung ba ci phyir bzod/ /mdzes ma'i kha yi chang gis dga' ldan pas/ /reg pa bdag gir byed nus ba klu la'ib/ /me tog kun dgar chags bde mi 'gog na/ /su zhig tshangs spyod gdung ba don du gnyer/ /gser gyi ba gam bzhad ldan phyogs kyi sgor//dril chung snyan sgrogs lha yi gzhal med khang / /rtag par longs su spyod pa'i mthu yod na/ /nges med bas mtha'i nags la su zhig sred/ /mdor na lang tsho'i dpal kun mi 'grib cing / /rang yid mdza' ba'i grogs dang mi 'bral bar/ /'dod la gtan du rol ba'i gdengs yod na/ /dam pa'i spyod la su zhig gus par 'gyur/ /'dod yon dbang po'i gzhu yi 'khri shing rgyud/ /lus med 'phrul gyis bdungs pa'i mda' lnga ba/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal ster ba'i mtshon cha ste/ /rnam par dpyad na 'jigs pa'i chos nyid can/ /de phyir rang sems glang po dran shesayigyis/ /rnal du 'god pa lcags kyu'i bsgyur stabs 'dis/ /kun rtog nyer zhi'i gom pa drang po'i stabs/ /bsam gtan nags mthar 'god la sems gtod cig /de skad smras pa'i mtha' der mkha' spyod kyi/ /rig 'dzin grub pa'i na chung smin legs ma/ /dran pa'i sem/sa kyi lhag ma bzhag nas kyang //ltar snang yul ni mi snang dbyings su song / /dus der kun rtog rang mdangs tshon lnga yis/ /legs bris dbang po'i gzhu yi dpal 'dzin 444
pa'i / /skal bzang snyan ngag rma bya gdugs mtshar po/ /re zhig sems la bsil ba'i rten du byas/ /ngoms pa med par 'dod pa'i yul kun la/ /'gyu ba'i ba rlabs 'grems pa yid kyi mtshor/ /dug gsum gdengs can glal ba'i ro 'dzin pa/ /thar 'dod rnams la 'jigs rung gshed ma yin/ /rtsod pa'i 'khor lo rnon po'i gzhan dbang can/ /snyigs ma'i phun tshogs chu shing nags myul bas/ /rang nyid bde bar rloms pa brgya lam na/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu grub kyang ya ma brlayi/ /de slad sdug bsngal rnam mang gar gyi ros/ /sems kyi rkang stabs brel ba'i 644)skyes//'dus byas rang mtshang blta bas yid brel ba'i/ /shugs ring rlung yab g.yob cing 'phen par byed/ /'on kyang kun gzhi'i dar dkar ngos yangs la/ /sngon goms bag chags sor rtses bris pa'i gzugs/ /legs spyad smon lam tshon brgya'i mdangs gsal ba/ /su zhig gis kyang 'gog par nus sam ci/ /slar yang lhag bsam shar ri'i phang ba nas/ /gsung 'phrin nyan byed lha mo sgeg ldan ma/ /snying nas mdza' ba'i 'od zer gdu bu'i tshogs/ /'khrol ba'i sgra snyan dbyangs su len pa thos/ /legs byas chu yi 'khri shing dog pa yi/ /pa tra mgrin par rol pa'i snyan ngag gtam/ /yid 'ong lku phreng mu tig phon po can/ /ngang ba'i bu mo kun dga'i do rar rna/ /rnyog pa'i dri ma rab bgrungs rnam dpyod kyi/ /rdzing bu rnam par 'phrul ba'i them skas can/ /rig byed gser gyi pad+ma bzhad pa'i tshal/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i bsung zhim spos su btul/ /grogs dag yid shes dpyid kyi pho nya mo/ /mdza' ba'i nags klung yangs por bag phebs kyang //869
'dod dashongs snying po'i kha zas ma thob pas/ /mgrin pa'i pi wang zeng ba rna bar snyan/ /sngon med snying gtam ga bur zegs ma yis/ /bsgos pa'i 'phrin yig mngar ba'i ro bro ba/ /ci yang dkar phyogs lha mo'i lag sor gyis/ /dga' mgur stabs pa yid ñtsā bcud du len/ /bag yod zang chang mngar pos snying myos pas/ /rang rang sems kyi do rar mngon 'dod kyi/ /gom pa 'degs 'ardzog mang ba'i stangs stabs kyang / /re zhig mdzes pa 'dog pa'i zol la brten/ /rig gzhung zab mo'i rdo rje rdul zang rgyun/ /'dren bzhim dal gyis 'bab pa sī /ske'i klungayi/ /tshig don g.yas su bskor nas rang blo'i mtshor/ /rba rlabs so dkar 'dzum nga 'i 'od snang 'grems/ /dpyad kyin bzang ba'i blo gros sa'i zla bayi/ /kun bzod mngal du gab byang rang bzhin nyid/ /'gyur med 'od kyi thig le —mkhar 'god pa/ /sgrib bral dngos po'i che ba yin mod myang / /las tshul lcags kyi srad bus 'ching ba dang / /lhan cig 'grogs pa'i margad 'dab ldan ma/ /gzhan dbang gzeb kyi snying por lus bcings pas/ /gcig pu'i sems kyi kun tog dbyangs su 'gyin/ /'dod pa'i chung ma gzhan bzhin yid kyi nor/ /'phrog pa 'i chom rkun lhan skyes ri dgas mig /ma 'dris mdza' ba dkar po'i la du zhig /phyosaṭa kyi mgrom/ por phrad skyes yin kyang slar/ /ringanas gnas kyang snying la 'bab pa yi/ /gtam snya na ska da kyi rol mos yid bcug pa/ /dbyar skyeri ge 'brug la rma bya'i bu mo/ bzhin/ /kun dgar rol ba sred na 'ga' 'gar shes/ /byams btsu'i dri bsung rgyas pa'i pad+ma dag/ra/ /rga/su ra gi ca/sang bas thos 'dzin nyer sim yang //870
khyod yu lnga ngon sum mthong ba 'chag 4da kyā 'i/ /la sa dngang sun pa'i yol ba 'de ci zhig /sum rtsen tshal dang klu dbang rong mtshungs par/ /gams5 kyi bskal nga sa rtag pa ra khyod zhal gyi/ /pad+ma tshar du dngar der rilta 'dod kyang / /lha yi bdud rtsi'i gtam bzhin snyan pa tsam/ /gzhung lugs 'o ma'i rgya mtshor rtsen pas yid/ /cung zad bsil ba'i dngos pos bzung min na/ /mya ngan tsha zer 'bar ba'i gdung byed 'dis/ /'tsho ba'i srog kyang kham zas byed pa snyam/ /'on kyang snying stobs zla 'od dal bu'i rlung / /brten phyir smon lam dag pa'i 'khar ba la/ /rang sems ngal 'tsho'i stegs bu 'dod bzhin du/ /dran pa'i khye'u phyogs der ya nga yang rgyu/ /rig 'dzin dga' mas brten pa'i nags kyi ljongs/ /ha ri tsan dan 'khri shing rdul tshogs kyis/ /phyogs kun dri bzang khang par bzhad pa'i mtsho/ /mthong ba min kyang yid kyi shes pa 'gul/ /rang sems lta bur gtsang byed lha yi rdzing / /gser ñtsha pad+ma bzhad pa'i snying po'i rdul//dba' rlabs sor mos legs bris tshangs pa'i mtsho/ /sngo bsangs khu ce yi lha mo'i gdengs ka gzhin/ /yil 'phrog shel gyi lhug phran rlung ba'o/na gyis/ /g.yo ldan chags pa'i mig yangs me tog mda'/ /bgrang yas smin lethas gzhu yi 'khri shing la/ /drangs te gdul bya'i snying la 'dir bsnun zhig /snyan pa'i nyams brgya ngag gi ku mu dar/ /rjes chags bka' yig ro ldan grub pa'i skyes/ /rnyog bral mos pa'i yidatsho kyi mkha' lam las/ /rgyu skar 'dzum pa'i rlabs bzhin 'phen par mdzod/ /bzang min las dbang can pa'i nas gyon te/ /'khrul snang khrag la rol ba'i phra men ma'i/ /871

lcang skya ngas/shadabang blo bzang chos ldan/lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzar chos ldan rna/ mdo smad tsang kha'i nye 'dabs g.yi dge'i char gtogs rta phyug ces pa 'i grong du/yab rgya rigs khe ba cang e har dang / yum lo bza' thar mo mtsho gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta (spyi lo1642) lor sku 'khrungs/thang ring dgon gyi khri pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang paṇa chen blo bzang chos/ rgyan gyis/ bla ma gong ma grags pa 'od zer gyi sku skye ru ngos 'dzin mdzad cing / de rjes bla ma chul khrims rgya mtsho dang phun tshogs bzang po gnyis kyi spyan sngar gtsug phud phul te rab tu byung / mtshan bstan 'dzin legs bshad rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ yi gi sbyor klog gi dbu tshugs/ /da gung lo dgu par dgon lung dga' ldan byams pa gling du phebs/ t+yā shu ba lcags glang (spyi lo1661) lor dbus lha ldan du phebs shing / kun4 gzigs lnga ba chen po'i spyan sngar dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ blo bzang chos ldan zhes1 pa'i ming gnang / 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/sgo mtha dpon slob ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho las bka' chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa shing 'brug (spyi 'o 1664) lor rgyal dbang lnga ba'i mdun bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom tha blangs/ nyar bdun par gling bza dang lha sa smon lam chen mor grwa skor mjad/ so gsum par 902
btsang du phebs/ shar rtse'i mkhan po slobazang pad+ma la rje'i gsung 'bum sogs ñtsha khrid dang / sngags pa dpon slob dge 'dun don grub pha la dbang lung rjes gnang mang po zhus/ shing yos lor yang bskyar du phebs/sngags chen dkon ca chog rgyal mtshan dang drung pa rgyal tshab pa sogs mkhas pa mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te mdo sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa mthar spyan mdzad/ mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/ dgung lo na gnyis pa chu phag (spyi lo1683) lor mdo smad du byon/ dgon lung ri khrod byang chub gling du bzhu yas / rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me yos (2 lo1687) lor khri chen klu nga bum rag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhabs phyi mdzad de rgya nag pe cin du phebs / sa 'brug (spyi 'o rnga 688) lor dgon lung gi khrir phebs/chu bya (spyi yo1 093) lor gong ma khang shis gdan 'dren ltar slar yang pe cin du phebs/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi byin gyis gong mas dbu blar ba'i ra/ de nas lo bzhi tsam pe cin du gsang bde 'jigs gsu ma gyi dbang dang rjes gnang / khrid lung gnang ba dang / dgi bsnyen dang rab byang gi sdom pa 'apogs/ pa sogs dam pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher bstsal/ dgu nga lo nga drug pa me glang(sgyi lo1697) lor rgyal dbang mchog la gser yig 'bul bar dbus su phebs/ ta la'i drug pa po ta la'i gser khrir mnga' gsol zhing dngos 'bul rgya chen phul/ phyi lor byang lam brgyud de pe cin du log gong mas mtsho bdun du lha khang gsar rgyan mdzad gari 'i gtsug las/ khang rten gsum thams cad rje 'di la gtad/ dgung lo re lnga ba me khyi (sbyi lo1706) lor nang mas kon ting phu'u shan bkang tshi nā gau nyi'i tsho mdzo wo903
(4rngakhya/’/ ca'u nga 'gas dang bdur thaca/ cam/nga / re dgu nga lcabs stan lor dgon 'u nga du phebs la dzu ge du sog lu la ñtsha da4na ) yongs la zhabs kyis bcags te dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi phab/ bdu 61 cu ba lcas/ di yos lor slar pe cin du phebs/ tsā dur jin dkon par nang rten bcas pa bzhengs/ dong ma zung gru zi zhes pa'i ming bstsal/ rnam dkar 'phrin las kyis sa kun khyab/ dgung lo don gsum pa rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing rta (spyi lo1714) lor sku gshegs/lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya rab gsal /rab gsal mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ / rmong45 pa 'i mun pa drungs 'byin cing / /blo gros snang ba rgyas mdzad pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs 'a phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po yi/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od po che sa/ /spo groṭa: legs nga ra gsa' byas pa/ /skal ldan bu khyod rtsa ba sh+lau]gas / /bka' shadag zu sa gong ma'i lugs srol ltar/ /bud bsnyeg rin lhub gsuca/ 'a/ songs pa/ /tshul bzhin nyams su bltar ba la/ /mi dang ra/thun /ga62①mi dgos mod/ /gzhan du dpal mgon 'phags pa lhasaḍū〉/ /mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /gsungs pas mi chos tshul mthun gces/ /gang la'ang bsam snyor gnyis po()las/ /bsam pa gtso ste 'phags pa lhas/ /chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro ste/ /yid gtso yid ni dam pa yin/ /gsungs 904
pas bsam pa gya gya dang / /bral ba'i rang bzhin drang ba dgos/ /bya ba gang la 'jug pa'i tshe/ /kun slong brtags nas 'chos pa gnad/ /sbyor ba mtho mnyam dman gsum dang / /bstun lugs gsum las dang po la/ /gtso bo yongs 'dzin bsten tshul ni/ /bla ma lnga bcu ba las shes//gzhan pa'i bla dpon mi chen la/ /phyag dang mngon du ldang ba dang / /zhes(zhe/sa'i gtam sogs lus ngag gi/ /gus pa'i rnam 'gyur skabs dang sbyar/ /'brom gyis mi chos gnad phreng0las/ /gzhan gyi tshogs dpon zhan na yang / /phyag sogs gus tshul bya bar gsungs/ /de yis mi chen gzhan la'ang mtshon/ /mnyam pa'i mi dang phrad na yang / /dman cha 'dzin dgos glang thang bas①/ /gang du su dang phrad pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid kun las dman blta zhing / /gzhan la bsam pa thag pa yis/ /gzhan nyid mchog tu 'dzin par gsungs/ /dman la'ang nga rgyal brnyas bcos dang / /khyad gsod mi bya mdo sde las/ /dge slong dman la brtas byas na/ /bskal par thar ba mi 'thob gsungs/ /'phags pa klungyis ji skad du/ /bdag nyid mtho bar 'dod pa de/ /ngan 'gro ngan dang glen par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa la sogs nyes dmigasache/ /spyir na su dang phrad na yang / /gshis mi dag cing rgyud mi sreg /skyon la mi rtog sun mi dbyung / /ha cang gsar 'grogs che mi bya/ /pha rol khams dang bsam pa la/ brtags nas rang bzhin ma nges par/ /'dris tshe blo gtod khyod shes dang / /ci zer kha la nyan mi bya/ /brtag cing dpyad nas blo bab bar/ /shes te 'grogs shing 'dris byas nas/ /rgyun 905
du pha rol seng sa sung zhing / /legs nyes phran bur dga' khro yi/ /rnam 'gyur mi ston phan btags pha/ /ma brjed drin gzo'i bsam pa bsten/ /cung zad sems dang ma mthun kyang / /kha la mi 'don sems kyis kyang / /go lod chen poskyomi sdom par/ /rar zhir 'gro ba'i thabs la 'bad/ /lhag par rang gi rogs byed la/ /sems kyis byams shing zas gos sogs//'khos dang bstun pa①skabs sbyar sbyin/ /'di lta ra byed dang ma byid kyi/ /bskab par pha rol swo nges bya/ /rgyun du rna ba sun mi 'jug /pha rol sems la gzan pa yi/ /tshig mda' 'phen bas sun mi dbyung / /bya ba gang dang gang rtsom kyang / /brtag dpyad legs par byas nas brtsam//dgi ba'i bya ba gang yin pa/ /brtsams nas mtha' ru dbyung la 'bad/ /nyes dmigs yod pa brtsams na yang / /byed 'phro bshol ba legs par 'gyur/ /sems 'di yur ba'i chu dang 'dra/ /gang du 'then pa de ru 'gro/ /de la grogs kyis 'then pa dang / /rang gis 'then pa rnam pa gnyis/ /rang dang mdza' ba'i grogs po yis/ /bya byed spyod lam legs nyes dang / /bzang ngan thos 'debs gang byed pa/ /de dang bstun pas de dbang 'gro/ /sngon nas ngan goms shas che bas/ /dran shes pa nga yang ma bsten na/ /bya ba ngan la blo phyogs pa/ /tsam gyis de yi dbang du 'gro/ /bzang po'i rigs la 'gro dka' yang / /phan yon bsam sa nas blo bcos phyin/ /yang dang yang du goms bcug na/ /nam zhig de yi dbang du 'gro/ /'jig rten mi chos rnal ma ni/ /rang cag rnams la mkho dgos med/ /bsam sbyor spyod lam bya byed kyang / /phag906
cher 'dul ba mdo sde sogs/ /dam pa rnams ñtsha legs bshad las/ /'byung ba ltar du bya bar 'bad/ /mtshan nyid theg pa'i0lam rim rna//sangs rgyas ko 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs/ /med mi rung ba yin pas na/ /'di la 'bad pa shin tu gces/ /rdo rje theg pa'ikhrulam rim ni/ /sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i cho4 ko / /bskal pa mang por mjal dka' ba/ /'di la bag chags 'dzog pa gnad/ /mang du brjod pa ci zhig dgos//rgyun par bla ma dkon mchog la/ /dad gus tshogs sogs sgrib sbyong dang / /dam pa'i gzhung mang blta rtog la/ /'bad na don chen 'grub par 'gyur/ /ces pa 'di ni rang gi slob bu rab 'byams spru ba blo bzang nyi mas 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul pa ltar ban rgan ngab dbang blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang pos rgyal khab pe'i cing gi bod chos lha [zu nga du sbyar ba'o// //mchan 'grel 0mjun 'jug ga'an dang ba lhun pa'am gsan dang mthunapo byed pa/ zhu)dpalamagona'aphags pa lha/ slob dpon ar+ya ) ba ste/ lo tsa sa bsdus pa par+ṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi〈〈bslab bya rinachen phreng mdzesari〉zhes pa'i mchan rtags angaphu'ilagazigs / ()bsam sbyor gnyis po/ sems gyikunaslong dang lus kyi lag len gnyis/ ()mi chos gnad phreng / 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i'abyung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i〈〈bslab bya mi chos gnad kyi phrer ba〉〉zhes pal bshad pa'o/ /0glang thang pa/ bka' gdams dge bshes glang thang pa rdo rje sepa1 ste/ rab byung dpapo'i shing rta (spyi lo1054)lor 'khrungs/907
rab byung gnyis pa'i chu bya(spyi lo1093) lor glang zang dgon ba btab/ chu yos(spyi lo1123)lor 'das/ zhu)'phags pa klu/ slob dpon klu sgrub ste/ lo rgyus mdor bcas ji dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i〈〈ku sgrub la bstod pa dad pa'i sgra dbyangs〉〉nas pa'i mchan rtags ang()lagazigs/ ()na lod chen po/ go ba gting zab mo'am rgya chen po lon pa'i don/ ()'khos dang bstun pa/ rang gi nus stobs dang bsnan pa/ ()mtshan nyid theg pa/phar phyin theg pa ste/ byang phyogs so bdun sogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu lam du byed pas/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa zhes pa'o/ /de dang rgyu'i theg pa dang donagacig rnam pa thams cad 9 mchog dang ldan pa'i stong ba nyid rgyu yin la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa gtso bor ston pa'i phyir rgyu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /(yirdo rje theg pa/ thabs shes dbyer mi phyed pa'i lda rje'i lam gyis rdo rje gsum mngon du rgyad pas lda rje theg pa zhes pa'o/ /de dang sngags kyi theg pa/ rig 'dzin theg pa/ 'bras bu'i theg pa rnams don gcigsngags dang phyag rgyari sgo nas dngos grub 'grub pa'i phyir sngags kyi theg pazhes dang / sngags spyod pa'i tshogs 7 'di nyid larig 'dzin gyi'abras bu thob bar byed pas rig 'dzin theg panas dang / 'gar ba med pa'i bde ba chenapo 'bras buri tshulas gnas pas de sngags kyi then pas dgu bor ston pas na la 'bras bu'i zad pa nas kyang bya'o//
bslab bya gces pa brtso brgyad pa/dge legs dpal ster bla ma dang / /bsku med skyabs mchog rin chen gsum/ /las kun sgrub pa'i sung ma'i tshogs/ /kun la dang bas phyag bgyis te/ /sngon bsags las smon gyis sbrel ba'i/ /dad gus skal ldan slob bu la/ /'di phyi kun tu phan pa yi/ /blang dor bslab bya mdor bsdus bri/ /btsan po'i khrims dang mi mthun pa'i/ /spyod pa kim pa'i 'bras①bzhin spang / /rang la ltos pa thams cad kyang / /tshul bzhin sgrub la sbyor ba gces/ /'grogs 'dris 'brel ba'i che phra la/ /legs nyes bya byed phra mo yis/ /dga' khro'i 'gyur ldog ring spang ste/ /gzhung bzang phyi thag bsring ba gces/ /gnyen dang nye du nang 'khor la/ /spyi snyom byams brtse'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /skabs dang sbyar te bab 'brel②dang / /mthu na pa'i skyong bran bya ba gces/ /dbang byar spyod pa'i sde mang la/ /nye ring ris su mi gcod cing / /thams cad byams pas skyong ba dang / /legs nyes rnam dbye 'phyed pa gces/ /dga' ba'i bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gyis/ /ngo bstod gzhan skyon gleng ba yi/ /gcam bus kha gsag smra ba la/ /rtog dpyo da zhib tu byed pa gces/ /blo ldan gya gyu'i sems med par/ /gnas tshul ji bzhin brjod pa yi/ /gtam gyi brjod byar legs brtags nas/ /snying bo dang du len pa ga ces/ /mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran/ /dma' la sdang ba'i bsam snyor gyis/ /909
rang gzhan gnyis ka phung 'gyur bas/ /ngan spyod 'di dag spong ba gces//rgan la gus shing mnyam la mdza'/ /dman la byams par rgyud pa yi/ /kun dang mthun pa'i ya rabs kyi/ /spyod pa kyur len byed pa gces/ /klu gar rgyan po 'gyed pa sogs/ /ha cang thal ba'i rtsed mo la/ /g.yeng ba don chen nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bag med spyod pa sdong ba gces/ /khyad par myos byed 'thung ba ni/ /dran med 'gyur bas mi khyu nas/ /'bud cing ngan 'gror skyur byed pas/ /dug chu bzhin du spong ba gces/ /rta rtsal 'phong dang gtam smra sogs/ /dpa' bo'i yang rtsal yon tan la/ /sbyong ba pho rab lugs yin pas/ /de rnams brtson pas sbyong ba gces/ /mdor na bsam sbyor bzang po yis/ /'jig rten spyod pa tshul mthun la/ /bslab na mtho ris thar ba'i rgyur/ /'gyur bas tshul bzhin slob pa gces/ /'on kyang chos dang mjal dus 'dir/ /'jig rten lugs las khyad par du/ /'phags pa'i nyams len bya dgos pas//'de ltar nyams su len pa gces/ /bla ma mchog gsum dam pa la/ /snyong nas re ltos dpung gnyen 'cha'/ /sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / /de la phyag ma chod byed pa gces/ /rab tu byung ba thams cad la/ /brnyas par mi bya dag snang dang / /gus pas bsnyen bkur phan 'dogs kyi/ /byaji ba sgrub la brtson pa gces/ /rgyun du bla ma dkon mchog la/ /skyabs 'gro bstod pa gsol 'debs dang / /gzungs sngags zab mo'i②bzlas brjod sogs/ /kha ton byed la brtson pa gces//bla ma'i rnal 'byor①skyabs 'gro dang / /lam rim lta ba phyag chen gyi/ /910
dmigs rim rnams la bsam pa dang / /sgom pa kyur len byed pa gces//'di ltar bgyis na gnas skabs dang / /mthar thus/ don chen bde blag tu/ /'grub par dam pa rnams kyis gsungs / /de phyir tshul 'dir 'bad pa gces/ /tshul 'dir 'bad la bla ma dang / /yi dam mcho ga gsum sung ma yis/ /byin rlabs dngos grub mchog stsol zhing / /gces par skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces lugs gnyis kyi blang dor gsal bar byed pa'i bslab bya gces pa bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba 'di rna rigs rus phun sum tshogs shing chos la dad 'dun dang brtson pa che ba'i dpon po har chin byams pa bkra shis kun rgyas 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul pa'i ngor 'jam dbyangs kong ma bzhwang ti'i lung gis kron ting phu'u shan bkang tshi nā kau shrī ming 4/zhan lcang skya hu thog thā zhes 'bod pa'i ban rgan ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang pos byamasachen lha khang du sbyar ba'o//mchan 'grel 0kem pa'i 'bras / dug shing gim pa sa/'i 'bras bu lte/ de lta nasdug cing ro mngar ba zhig yin la/ thos pas dug gis gtsis te 'chi 'gro bar grags/ zhwa'ibab 'brel/ babs 'brel dang don gcig ste/ gnas tshul dngos dang mthun ma'am 'os tho kyi 'brel ba/zlogazuras sngags zab mo/ lha'i sku dang gsung lda 4 gtso bor sgrub byed bde stong yi gir shar ba'i sngags zab mo/ dubla ma'i rnal 'byor/rang gi sems rgyud bla ma'i rtogs pa rnal ma'i thog tu 'apyor ba'i thabs la zer zhing / bsgom tshul 'i rang gi bsgom pa'i lha gang yin pa de dang rang gi bla ma gnyis ngo bo dbyer med du sgom pa'i cho ga zhig go/ /9/sgyu
rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo je rna/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa byi (spyi lo1648) lor yab dbal shul dpal 'bum rgyal dang yum thar mo byams gnyis kyi sras su bsang gi rdo ger lhas khra ting zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ dgung 'o bdun nas] khu bo dge slong bsod nams kyun grub kyi mdun du yi ge'i 'bri klog sbyangs/ bcu gsu ma par khyu mchog ye shes rgya mtsho ba la rab byung dang dpal gcig gi rjes gnang zhus/ chos mang du gsan/ nyer gcig pa sa sprel (spyi lo1668) lor dbus su byon/'bras spungs sgo mang chos grwar slob dpon blo gros rgya mtsho las mdo phyogs kyi chos phal cher gsan/ dgung lo nyer lnga ba la gsang phur dka' bcu ba'i mtshan btags blangs/ de'i phyi lor chos khri ser por grwa skor mdzad/dgung lo nyer bdun pa shing stag (spyi lo1674) lor kun gzigs lnga ba chen po las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sngagasakyi gzhung 'ga' zhig dang sgra snyan ngag zhor chos su bslabs/ sngags pa dpon slob tshu' khrims na tshan can/pha bong kha ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rgyal sras me rgan rin po che/ grub chen sha bo ba/ grags pa bla ma bsod nams las zab chos mang du gsan/952

sbar bar rtsom/ /de lta na yang sakhyo/na don du/ /sros/ kyang 'phangs med gtong ba gang / /srid kyi ched du g.yul 'khrugs kyi/ /gdug pa ji ltar khas/ blangs byed/ /rtswa rtse'i zil ba zhig r+b+ya 'i phyir/ /〉nga ri 2 cha su yis 'bad pa byed / /de bzhin 'chi ba'i chos can dag )rir+sha / kyang dpa'ajibo'i gnas thob min/nga /des na nyes kun bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /nyon mongs las gzhan dgra yi blo/ /bdag la yod pa min no zhes/ /dam pa'i rang rtags gsal bar sgrogs/ /'khrugs pa'i rgyu rna rnam spangs pas/ /phun tshogs dpal gyi rnam ro' yang / /slo nga ba'i skye lo phongs gtsu yis/ yid la gdungs pa 'dzin pa de/ /rig 'dzin mdzes ma'i dga' ston gyi/ /dga' ba bltar ba'i sa gzhi la/ /dus kyi 'phang los rab bgrod pa/ /zhag gi 'khor lo bdun pa'i nyin/ /seng gi ral ba gseg mtshungs shing / /srin po khros pa'i nga ro can/ /chu yi 'khri shing rnam dkrigs pa/ /mtsho 'gram 'jigs rung blta bar gshegs/ /der rna mkha' ldang za res mtshon pa'i gos/ /nor rgyasayilung gis 'chang ba dung gi gtsug /bya ngan khur gyis non pa'i skyed ma bcas/ /snying rje'i gzigs pa yangs pa'i spyan sngar byung / /na tshod phra mo'i yal 'dab ma smin par/ /nye dbang shing rtayimanyes pa'i mchod sbyin res/ /dus min babs pa dung gi gtsug phud yum/ /lda rje'i tsher ma snying la zug pa bzhin/ /shugs ring drag por ldang ba'i dri bzhon gyis/ /lus kyi 'khri shing kun nas tshugs bral zhing / /mya ngan zug rngu'i yi gi nyams pa yi/ /snying rje'i sme snga gas ngu 'bod lhang lhang grags/ /de mthong yid 'byung brtse ba'i 'phrul 'khor956
gyis/ /thugs rje'i rgya mtsho kun nas cher g.yos te/ /bsil ba'i spu long gos dkar 'dzin pa'i steng / /mchi ma'i do shal gsar bas brgyan par gyur/ /gzhan don kyur len gang dag gzhan don du/ /brtse ba tsam ma yang bu la min/ /gtong ba myur len gang dag gtong ba la/ /thro ba de tsam phongs pa nor la min/ /lang tsho pad mo'i 'dab phreng rnam rgyas bu yi rdzing bu dang bral bas/ /lag 'gro ma 'di'i 'tsho ba'i me tog nges pa nyid du skem 'gyur phyir/ /blo dang rigs pa'i thabs rang zhig gis klu mo ma smad srog bsung zhes/ /rig 'dzin gzhon nu'i snyingo gi zla bas kun rtog ri bong mtshan ma 'dzin/ /lan la re dang grags 'dod snyon pa'i gar/ /ma yin 'gro ba nyam thag sgrol ba'i blos/ /sgyu ma'i lus4yikyis gser mig mchod 'dod pas/ /lto 'gro ma las gos dmar mtshan ma bslangs/ /rgyu med brtse ba'i ngang tshul 'di yis ni/ /gdengs can lhag par mnyes gshin thob pa'i rgyus/ /bla ba las ni me char spro ba bzhin/ /gdung ba'i dbyu gus snying gi rnga drag rdungs/ /las kyi byed pas lag 'gro bdag cag rnams/ /klu dbang dgra yi zas su sprul pa ste/ /'gro gsum dga' ba'i nyer 'tsho khyed kyi lus/ /men rmongs bdag don ji ltar btang bar 'os/ /de phyir brtse ba'i byams pa'i dbang gyur khyod/ /bdag gi thu ]sa khral yongs su thongs mdzod ces/ /dung gi gtsug ni gdengs ka rnar hūm̐ /dīng/ ca/tsho/rgya snan shu 'iso kā bapa'i ma~X me long ma~X/ ༵༵ /lha'/ ston/ska ༵ gh+nā // dmar zung / /rig 'dzin yum gyis bskur ba gzhon nu 'des/ /gzhan 957
don 'bras bcas ched du 'ongs pa bzhin/ /de 'phral keng rus ri b+thā brtsegs pa'i ngogs/ /gdengs can khrag gi chu klung 'khyil ba der/ /brtan ldan snying stobs gsal ba mngon byas te/ /'jigs med dpa' bo'i blo yis rab tu zhugs/ /de tshe bser bus skyod pa yis/ /sa 'dzin 'khri shing g.yo ba dka /gzhon nus thub chod ma mdzad ces/ /brtse bas ring nas bzlog pa bzhin/ /rlabs kyi lag pas yang yang du/ /dbul kyang dzog par ma nus pas/ /chu gter ma ni bzhin gnag ste/ /mya ngan byed par mtshon pa bzhin/ /ji ltar gdengs can srog blu phyir/ /mkha' lding 'bab stegs 'dzigs pa bzhin/ /tsan dan byug pa'i lus ldan pa/ /gzhon nu mas kyang bde ma byas/ /zla ba nor bu'i mal stan la/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug rab rtsen pa'i/ /bde de 'di yis gsod sa yi/ /rdo khri der ni rnam par thob/ /de nas dus mtha'i me dpung gyon pa'i ri/ /'jig pa'i rlung dang 'grogs nas rgyu ba bzhin/ /rgya mtsho rab 'khrugs 'dab ma'i rlung sgra can/ /'dab chags dbang bo mgyogs pa'i shugs kyis 'ongs/ /'bar ba'i gshog 'dab rlung gis 'thor ba yi/ /'tshub ma'i rdul sprin chu mthongs 'gog pa las/ /rdo ba'i ser chen 'be+ebs pa'i drag shul bcas/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu'i rgyab tu thog ltar babs/ /nam mkha' sgrib byed nya ma 'bar ba'i lus can de yi rdo rje'i mchu/ /lto 'gro'i snying dag 'byin spru gang gis mngon par btab ste sa 'dzin rtser/ /za bar byed tshe sa gzhi dag ni 'jigs pa bzhin du 'dar byed cing / /srid pa'i nor bu mog por gyur pa'i som nya'i khyogs la rab tu 'phyang / /'on kyang 958
rmongs pas long gyur cing / /zas la srid pas drangs pa des/ /gzhon nu'i gtsug gi dum bu dag /nor bu 'od dmar lta bur blangs/ /'di las rig 'dzin 'di yi yid/ /gdengs can don du gdungs pa la pad ma'i 'dab dang rdo rje bzhin/ /mnyen dang sra ba lhan cig thob/ /lus kyi gdungs pa rab 'dzin yang / /yid ni dga' ba'i bzhin ras gsal/ /srog la rgol ba'i rnam 'tshe 'ang / /mdza' ba'i ma bzhin mig gis blta/ /dga' ba'i ku long gis byugs pa/ /kun da'i gnyen ltar dkar ba yi/ /snying stobs rab gsal 'od zer gyi/ /myu gus khengs par gyur pa ba'i/na/ /lda rje'i mchu can mchu yis ni/ /gzhon nu'i snying ka 'bags pa bzhin/ /rgyal bu'i byams/ pa'i ra nga bzhin gyis// /mkha' lding snying gi brtan pa 'drag /gang tshe de yi gtsug gi nor/ /sprin gyi tog gi bste gnas su/ /thun mtshams gas ra bas sbags pa yi/ /zla ba'i cha bzhin mkha' las babs/ /de yi rtog bcasayiganyis 'thung gis/ /yid mtsho'i nyag pa rab bslangs pas/ /yab yum mna' mar bcas pa dag /yud tsam ci yang rig ma gyur/ /dri bco/na bser bu'i reg pa yis/ /dran pa dal gyis thob pa de/ /rig 'dzin gzhon nu 'tshol ba'i phyir/ /rings par 'dab bzang 'bab stes/sa phyin/ /de skabs chu gter ngogs su ko 1rna/ /mchod pa'i don du song ba dung gi gtsug /gsod pa'i gos dmar mtshan mas thod bcings nas/ /mkha' ldeng 'bab stegs can du myur bar 'ongs/ /sgra gcan gyis zos zla ba'i dmar ba yis/ /mya ngan rjes chags mtshon pa'i kun gsal bzhin/ /959
'gro gsum mi da kyi dga' ba zum byed pa/ /rab 'jigs mang rus 'bar ba'i gzugs can mthong / /khrag gsar thun mtshams char gyis sbags pa'i lus/ /zhag ldan m+bu ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa de/ /smin gyi bzhonanpar nges rtogs zil ba'i thigs/ /tsit+ta'iyisar khyim ha la sa rnam par 'bab/ /'phral la rmongs pas skrag pa btang ba yis/ /mkha' lding dbang po'i drung du mngon btud de/ /zas kyi res babs klu ni kho bo ste/ /gzhan phan brtson pa de yis bdag lus bsrungs/ /gdengs can la 'os rtags rna ma brtags par/ /rig 'dzin 'di rna ci yi slad du zos/ /sdig pa'i khur chen theg pa'i stobs ldan khyod/ /'jigs pa 'i dmyal ba mthong bar 'gyur ro zer/ /mya ngan dug gis rin pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /sdur ma'i ngang tshul spangs pa'i dpa' skyes te/ /'dab bzang sgra tsam bsnyen dka' dung gi gtsug /bsdigs pa'i mu cor 'dzem med sgrogs la ltos/ /kyi hug skye rgu'i 'dod 'jo yongs 'du'i ljon/ /'jig rten phan bde nyer 'joms sdig pa'i rgyu/ /byed po khyod ni nges par dug 'dzin zhes/ /lto 'gro'i bu ni rang la ngan bgrang byed/ /dung gi gtsug dang sprin gyi bzhon pa gnyis/ /'gyod dang dga' ba lhan cig thob gyur te/ /yid skyes 'khri shing dga' mas rang gi ni/ /bdag por 'bod pa'i smre sngags gtam 'di rnyed/ /rna ba'i tsher ma rnon po'i sgro ldan des/ /rmongs pa'i cho ga rab rdzogs sprin gyi tog /btsun mo'i 'khor bcas rgyal bu'i drung lhags pa/ /srid pa'i phun tshogs 'bras med mtshon pa bzhin/ /gzhon na'i gnas tshul mthong dang thos pa yis/ /yid kyi chu gter dkrugs shing 960
'khrugs pa las/ sa bdag lta byed mtsho skyes 'dab lnga dang / /zil ba'i thigs phreng dgod bzhin 'di skad zlo/ /gang zhig klu ni gcig nyid bsung phyir skyed byed gtsos pa'i gnyen kun bcom/ /gang gi rgud pa ma lus sel phyir kun kyang gdungs pa'i gnas la snyor/ /gang dag byams pas rnam par 'khrul bzhin bzod pa yis ni nyes byas bzhin/ /gang yang ma dpyad thub chod las 'di'i legs byas ci zhig byed do lo/ /yab yum gnyen gyi gdungs pa yis/ /yid la zug rngu bskyed pa de/ /snying la 'bab 'os ro ldan tshig /bdud ji'i mchod yon 'di bzhin zengs/ /sung ba'i go cha mchog gi bzod pa dang / /bslu med gnyen gyi mchog gi gtong ba yis/ /gces par bskyangs kyang don med 'jig 'gyur ba'i/ /sgyu lus g.yar bo 'di la su zhig chags/ /lha lags 'dir rna bsod nams las kyi zhing / /'di nas pha rol 'bras bu'i ston thog ste/ /gang zhig 'dir byas gzhan du spyad 'gyur zhes/ /gtong ba'i phan yon sras kyis mang du gleng / /zas la rkam pa'i drag shul rkan gyi sgras/ /sa 'dzin 'dar bar rtsom pa myur len pa/ /zhag chen btung bas mig 'bras ser ba yi/ /mkha' lding rmongs pas bslus pa da gzod rig /tshul 'des 'gyod pa'i me 'bar ban ta askyes/ /skrag pa'i mig gis phyogs su rnam bltas kyang / /yid ni bsil ba'i thabs gzhan ma mthong bas rta gdong me klong mchong bar rtsom pa la/ /lus srog sbyin pas smin byas te/ /legs pa'i lam du 'dzud 'dod pa/ /blo ldan de yis rings par ni/ /legs byas gtam gyi kyo bas drangs/ /ldag pa me yis mi bsregs te/ /96 1
chu yis kyang ni 'dag mi nus/ /sems can kun la byams pa dang / /bsod nams rgyun ni dbang bas sgrub/ /khro ba'i me gzhil chags pa'i chu bo skems/ /rmongs pa'i mun sel khrims kyi brtul zhugs longs/ /dam pa'i bshis bsten sdig las zlog byed na/ /ngan pa'i 'bras bu myong bar yongs mi 'gyur/ / zhi ba'i ro ldan bdud ji de yis ni/ /sems ni las rung thob pa 'dab chags dbang / /yon tan gter gyur rgyal bu'i rjes bstan bzhin/ /rigs pa'i lam bsten yi dam brtan po 'cha'/ /dam pa rnams ni ji ltar rgud kyang mdza' ba'i gzhungs pa'ang mi 'gyur te/ /'dam na gnas kyang pad mo rnams ni chu yi tog mas gos pa med/ /sha bral rus pa'i 'phrul 'khor la brten srog gi lhag ma nyid thob kyang / /gzhan phan bsam pas chu sbyin byed②de 'tsho ba gtong bas mi ngoms bzhin/ /de nas de rna dri bzhon gyi/ /rtse dgas skyod pa'i 'khri shing bzhin/ /lus po 'dar bas yab yum la/ /phyi phyag mtshon pa'i ngal ba bcas/ /yab gcig mi rtag dran pa yis/ /mya ngan rmongs pa'i rnam pa thongs/ /gang zhig dam pa'i bsten bya ba/ /brtse ba yin gyi phun tshos/sa min/ /rgud pa dag ni bde ba'i mtha'/ /dpal 'byor nyon mongs dag la mdza'/ /g.yo ba'i 'jig rtenababagrod pa la/ /legs spyad zlogacig pu brtan pa'i grogs/ /de skad tshig gis mtshon pa'i don/ /gdos bcas lus⑥kyis ston pa bzhin/ /gzhan phan thugs kyi rdzogs pa gang / /mdza' ba gsal ba'i lhag mar gyur/ /gzhon nu'i nyi mas dben pa yis/ /mun 'dzin bzhin gyi mkha' ngos la/ /mchi ma'i skar 963
tshoyos bkra ba can/ /chos spyod ma ni 'di skad lo/ /lang tsho'i bsod pa ma rdzogs shing / /'byung 'khrugs smrin gyis bsgribs min par/ /yon tan 'od stong lda na pa nyid/ /glo bur du rna gang du gshegs/ /tshig mda'i dbang bo'i tshig gi nus mthu dang / /'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi yod nges na/ /sprin gyi bzhon pa sos par mdzod cig ces/ /phyogs kyi 'jig rten skyong ba grogs su sbran/ /kye ma mi rtag srin po yis/ /'jigs skyed nyam thag nga ro ni/ /mthu chen zhi bar mnal ba dag /zugs rje bskul ba'i rol mor che/ /de yis brnyal gsos⑥mkha' ldeng dbang / /mkhar nyal gtso las④bdud rtsi ni/ /blangs te gdengs can bkum pa dag /gso bar bya zhes lha yul 'phur/ /bzod med shugs ring rlung gis sbar ba'i mes/ /sems kyi yam shing bsregs pa grub bdag mo/ /khyo bral ngang mo mtsho mthar lus pa ltar/ /phyogs der 'dran byed blta bas brel bzhin du/ /snying la snying 'dra'i gzugs brnyan 'ashog med du/ /yang yang 'char ba'i bsam gtan 'khor mo nas/ /mchi mas 'gags pa'i mgrin pa 'dzer 'o las/ /snying rje'i cho nge gseng mthor 'di skad bablo/ /gser gyi 'khri shing dman pa nyid byed mtshar sdug rnam 'gyur zla ba'i grogs/ /mthon mthing mig gis ut+pal dpal 'phrog bzhin ras pad mos mdzes pa can/ /grags pa'i tha rlabs rgya mtsho'i mthar 'khyud lang tsho dga' ba'i gzhir gyur pa/ /dam pa'i tshul bzang bdud rtsi'i reg pas bdag gi yid rna lhag par gdungs/ /kye ma 'khor ba mtshan mo'i chu 'dzin rum/ /mngon dga'i 'od snang yud tsam gsal ba can/ /yid bsubs mtshams snyor 53
glog gi sgron me yis/ /'gro gsum mun pa'i mal du 'jug par byed/ /'dod pa'i lag 'gro dug gi mes bskyed pa'i/ /du ba'i rnam 'phrul chags ldan zur mis ga das/ /'jig rten snying 'jigs dga' ma'i thugs phyung nas/ /bde ba'i gnas gzhan bzhed de gshegs sam ci/ /rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ba'i rtse dga' la/ /rol pa'i dam pa ri skyes la sa thob ste/ /re 'bras log par smin pa phra men ma'iphya/ /dmod pa'i gnam lcags byed po yongs mi shes/ /gau ri'i mchog byin bden tshig bdud rtsi'i zer/ /skal ngan bdag la gdungs byed me ru gyur/ /las kyis bsgribs pa'i yi dwas/sa 'ga' zhig la/ /lam gsum 'bab rdzipa'i klung chen skem par snang / /brnag dka'i sdug bsngal me lces bsregs gyur cing / /snying khur tsan dan chu las lhag par grang / /mya ngan ri po'i khur gyis non gyur kyang / /rnam rig rgyu ba dpyid kyi rlung ltar 'phyo/ /chags pa'i 'dab ma dar ba'i tshal bska mas kyang / /sred pa'i rkang drug mi sdod 'phur zhing lding / /srog dang bral yang 'tsho ba mi gtong ba'i/ /dam pa 'di ko su zhig gis ni byin/ /sems med lus kyi tshal 'di yang dang yang / /grogs med gcig pur rgyu ba'i ngal ba bdag /tshe rabs phyi mar khyod kyi drung 'khor du/ /skye bar shog ces smon lam nan tan mdzad/ /thun gsum mun pa'i sgrib g.yogs bsal ba na/ /bcu gnyis bdag po 'char ba su yis khogs/ /de bzhin rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa na/ /gzhon nu'i mtshan dpe slar yang mngon par 'gyur/ /de lta na yang mdza' ba'i dbang song dag /'bral ba'i gdungs pa yun ring banag dka' bas/ /964
